summary: Immix Biopharma filed an 8-K to disclose positive interim clinical trial data from its Phase 2 NEXICART-2 study of NXC-201 in relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis. The filing reports that all four MRD-negative patients converted to complete response, with an overall CR rate of 95% and no relapses. No corporate transaction or special situation is announced—the filing is a routine operational update under Items 7.01 and 8.01. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. The sole purpose is regulatory disclosure of clinical data, with no implications for shareholder meetings, acquisitions, or capital structure.
